directory_metadata: All observed directories and original modes retained in .tree.json; tar members are normalized regular-file data with mode0644,uid/gid0,mtime0.

early_ephemeral_fixtures.role: Earlier layout default fixture root; separate layout records report its retention loss.
Initial portability RED default fixture root; raw XML/stdout/stderr are retained here.

external_inputs: See EXTERNAL_INPUTS.json. Full host runtimes, protected controllers, original corpus/dependency bare stores and prior raw registration inputs remain external.
scope: Every observed regular byte under the six assigned roots is retained. This is not a claim that every earlier ad hoc development run or deleted temporary fixture survives. No absent artifact was recreated.

symlinks.retention: Exact path/target/mode retained in each .tree.json. No symlink target is followed by packaging; link objects are metadata-only, not tar members.
